name: add_express_query_filter
description: Adds ANDed name/category/price filtering across repository and route
prompts: GET /products currently returns all products. Add filtering across both layers: (1) add a search method to ProductRepository in src/repository/productRepository.js taking an options object { q, category, maxPrice } - q is a case-insensitive substring match on name, category is exact, maxPrice is an inclusive upper bound - returning matches (all products when no options); (2) wire q, category, and maxPrice as optional query parameters on GET /products in src/routes/products.js (maxPrice arrives as a string - convert it to a number). Combining filters ANDs them. Keep the response shape {id, name, category, price} and the original order.
